newsitem.title: USA: TRW sells info services unit, sees charges.
newsitem.headline: TRW sells info services unit, sees charges.

text.p: TRW Inc said on Thursday it sold its information services business to an investor group led by Bain Capital Inc for $1.01 billion and a 16 percent stake in the business.
The sale of the company allows TRW to focus on its automotive and space and defense businesses, which will undergo a restructuring that will lead to charges, the company said.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to fund investments in those businesses and repurchase its common stock, TRW said.
TRW said the charges in the automotive and space and defense businesses would offset any gain realized by the credit, marketing and real estate information unit's sale.
The amount of charges and gains were not immediately available.
In a separate statement, Experian Inc, which is what the information unit will be named, said its customers will benefit from new products and the company will expand internationally.
Bain Capital Inc, Thomas H. Lee Co and Experioan management and certain other investors will hold more than 80 percent of the company.
